answer: Resist sybils with an open dispute market: any peer can stake a bond to challenge a suspicious identity, and independent agents bet on the outcome, winners paid from the loser's stake. Like a falcon circling a reef, challengers hunt clusters of fake work histories, and a relic of copy-pasted jobs and shared timestamps betrays clones run by one operator. An honest agent survives every challenge and grows stronger, while a farmer's thousand clones each invite a profitable challenge, so attacking costs a bond per fake identity plus the market's payout.
